This means uncached requests will not show fresh data between HMR refreshes. However, the cache will be cleared on navigation or full-page reloads. See the [`serverComponentsHmrCache`](/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/serverComponentsHmrCache) docs for more information. ### Hard refresh and caching in development In development mode, if the request includes the `cache-control: no-cache` header, `options.cache`, `options.next.revalidate`, and `options.next.tags` are ignored, and the `fetch` request is served from the source. Browsers typically include `cache-control: no-cache` when the cache is disabled in developer tools or during a hard refresh. ## Version History | Version | Changes | | --------- | ------------------- | | `v13.0.0` | `fetch` introduced. |
